name: Cathedral Window
description: Cathedral window patchwork: squares of cream muslin, a curved window of bright fabric on every seam, the muslin rolled back round each one.

code.style: --rule: ( background: linear-gradient(var(--color1), var(--color1)) 50% 50% / 96% 96% no-repeat; @random(${shapeFrequency}) { :before { content: ''; position: absolute; left: -21%; top: 0; width: 42%; height: 100%; background: radial-gradient(closest-side, transparent 84%, var(--color2) 84%), @p(var(--color3), var(--color4), var(--color5), var(--color6)); -webkit-clip-path: @var(--lv); clip-path: @var(--lv); -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; } :after { content: ''; position: absolute; left: 0; top: -21%; width: 100%; height: 42%; background: radial-gradient(closest-side, transparent 84%, var(--color2) 84%), @p(var(--color3), var(--color4), var(--color5), var(--color6)); -webkit-clip-path: @var(--lh); clip-path: @var(--lh); -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; } } -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; );
